notes: On 26 February 2024, farmers and supporters staged a protest in Frankfurt (Oder) (Brandenburg), blocking the city bridge with some vehicles and causing traffic disruptions. The protest aimed to address agricultural concerns and was part of a nationwide demonstration movement against the federal coalition government and its agricultural policies.
evidence: farmers blocking the city bridge in Frankfurt (Oder) against the federal coalition government and its agricultural policies

notes: On 27 February 2025, at around 6:25 pm, around 100 people gathered in Berlin - Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf (Berlin) to demonstrate against an event featuring Austrian far-right figure and Identitarian Movement Austria (IBOE) member Martin Sellner. The demonstration first took place outside the restaurant where the event was taking place on Uhlandstrasse, before moving towards Bundesallee. Shortly before the police arrived, a participant sprayed pepper spray into the restaurant, causing eye irritation to at least one event attendee. Demonstrators later attempted to obstruct attendees from leaving the venue but eventually dispersed following verbal warnings by the police. The demonstration concluded shortly after 9:00 pm, with five demonstrators remaining. Authorities launched an investigation into the pepper spray incident as a case of dangerous bodily harm.
evidence: demonstrate against an event featuring Austrian far-right figure and Identitarian Movement member Martin Sellner

notes: On 10 July 2022, people gathered outside the Prefecture in Genova to show their support for the Chief prosecutor of Catanzaro, who was threatened by the mafia. The Agende Rosse Movement organized the demonstration. A FdI council member took part in the event.
evidence: support for the Chief prosecutor of Catanzaro, who was threatened by the mafia

notes: On 30 March 2024, residents of Novi Beograd and activists marched and blocked the road in Belgrade - Novi Beograd, voicing their dissatisfaction with the local government's plans to build a skyscraper within the green areas of this part of the city.
evidence: dissatisfaction with the local government's plans to build a skyscraper within the green areas of the city

COBAS affiliates, road maintenance workers and unoccupied people, some of them affiliated with the local '7 November' and 'New Benches' movements, gathered outside the Prefecture, in Plebiscito square, in Napoli (Napoli, Campania) to demand answers regarding their professional future and ask to meet with the Labor Minister, visiting the city's mayor on that day. At least one umbrella was thrown at a police cordon standing outside the Prefecture, generating tension.
evidence: former workers gathered to demand answers regarding their professional future and to meet the Labor Minister

evidence: opposition against the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Bill which proposes to give police more powers to shutdown peaceful protests

notes: On 19 March 2025, overnight, unidentified individuals set fire to a van parked in front of a police station in Stuttgart (Baden-Wuerttemberg) in a symbolic act of solidarity with political prisoners, particularly antifascists and leftists. A statement claiming responsibility, published on the Indymedia platform, described the arson as a response to state repression, including public manhunts, house searches, long prison sentences, and the criminalization of left-wing activism. The statement also called for continued militant politics by women against patriarchy, war, fascism, and in support of the class struggle.
evidence: arson in solidarity with political prisoners, described as a response to state repression and the criminalization of left-wing activism

notes: On 27 March 2021, around 200 cars participated in a vehicular protest through Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina, demanding a change to the city electoral system after a popular mayoral candidate dropped out of the race.
evidence: vehicular protest demanding a change to the city electoral system after a mayoral candidate dropped out

notes: On 24 October 2020, people gathered in Mont-de-Marsan, at the call of unions (UNSA, CGT, FCPE, SUD), the MRAP, LDH, La Cimade, PCF, Generation.s, Amnesty International, Muslim organizations, and MP. They demonstrated as part of a national tribute to a teacher, deadly attacked days before. They also demonstrated for freedom of speech.
evidence: national tribute to a teacher, deadly attacked days before; they also demonstrated for freedom of speech

notes: On 1 May 2025, people participated in a protest organized by the Socialist Party and the National Congress of Industrialists and Entrepreneurs, marching from the Circus to the Opera and Ballet Theatre in Chisinau - Buiucani. The demonstration was directed against the PAS leadership and the president, calling for social justice and dialogue with Russia. The protest was led by Socialist Party members of Parliament. There are indications that participants were brought to the event via organized transportation. The Soviet song 'Katyusha' was played during the event.
evidence: demonstration directed against the PAS leadership and the president, calling for social justice

evidence: 'Serbia against violence' march triggered by mass murder events, blaming the violence-contaminated public discourse and calling on the government to take responsibility

evidence: demonstrate in solidarity with Alfredo Cospito, on hunger strike against the 41-bis prison regime, and other anarchists charged
